name: Beaumont New Ammonia (formerly OCI Clean Ammonia), Beaumont, Texas
description: Expected to be one of first ammonia plants paired with autothermal reforming and 95% CO2 capture; lifecycle intensity ~0.8 tCO2/tNH3 vs 2.3 tCO2/tNH3 unabated (contracted threshold with Linde; subject to ExxonMobil CCS start-up and permits). Owner page read, last updated 25 Aug 2026.

capacities.basis: Capacity as stated on the cited page.
